notes.title: Clayverse Update – New Ship Repairs & Upgrades!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="TuobNyXn9mc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone! It’s been a little while since our last update, but we’ve been busy working on some cool new stuff for the game, and we’re excited to share it with you.[/p][p]When you first start your journey, the spaceship is going to be in rough conditions. You’ll now need to use some of the [b]clay [/b]you collect during your missions to [b]repair[/b] and [b]upgrade[/b] the ship. This will open up many new gameplay possibilities, like:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crafting[/b]: Craft powerful gear to help you survive tougher situations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customisation[/b]: Personalise your appearance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Talent Trees[/b]: Unlock new skills and abilities as you level up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Locations[/b]: As you progress, you’ll get to explore farther planets.[/p][/*][/list][p]And this is just the start – we’ve got a lot more ideas in the works to keep expanding and improving this feature going forward. [/p][p]Check out the sneak peek video below! (Heads up, it's still a work in progress, so the transition is a little rough right now, but we’re on it.)[/p]
